name: Bun ngan
summary: Bún ngan is a noodle soup of bamboo shoots and duck meat, one of the bowls around Quần Ngựa in Ba Đình.
origin: Hanoi, in the Ba Đình note on Vietnam Tourism’s stadium food page.
where: Hạnh Bún Miến Ngan, 63 Cửa Bắc, Quán Thánh, Ba Đình.
seoTitle: Bun ngan — Hanoi duck and bamboo noodles
seoDescription: Bún ngan in Hanoi is a noodle soup of bamboo shoots and duck. The door is 63 Cửa Bắc, Ba Đình.
